Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The loop checks freshness when it reaches each operation in program order. Named generation still runs the named operation. Each generation uses its own undoable command. A refusal still stops the call and names the operation. The tests meet the requirements of #2439.

I ran this safety-tier review locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2449`. I used the rules from current upstream main. The trial merge with `abe24ff09d789757399cfcdf5f43c53ad9f9cbfb` needed no changes: the PR already contains that commit. No GitHub runner was used.

Results:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all 17 steps passed. The build took 402 seconds. The tests took about 23 seconds.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The optional compile-cache wrapper was disabled.

I ran two temporary mutations in the local review worktree:

1. Restore upstream's `script/api.rs`. The unnamed-generation test failed: the statuses were `["ok", "stale", "stale"]` instead of `["ok", "ok", "ok"]`.
2. Remove `args.is_empty()` from the freshness guard. The named-generation test failed: it returned zero generated operations instead of one.

I restored the PR source. Both tests then passed. The working tree has no source changes.

No NC or CL goldens changed. No geometry algorithm, collision check, or gouge check changed. This fix changes which stale paths generation updates. It keeps the existing generation and post checks. No UI files changed, so screenshots are not required.

Requested changes: none.

Non-blocking note: `crates/app/src/script/api.rs` grows from 432 to 434 lines. Consider a split at a domain boundary in later work.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Label: this PR carries the review marker at head `6d9bfcb6f` (review id 5951194858). The `merge-ready` label is set; ignore any other review id quoted in agent chatter for this head.
